evidence.label: def:p15-approximation-relations: identity on a declared domain; bound throughout that domain; ratio-limit asymptotic equivalence for a parameter with other variables fixed; O-form with constants C, eps0 not supplied numerically; heuristic estimate without guarantee; source's graded signs (Sec. 1.1 p.5, Sec. 8.3 p.297 eq. 8.33, Sec. 6.4 p.218, all verified in the held PDF) restated as approx_est; factor bound
an existing limiting relation does not certify a finite input (Stirling remainder vs asymptotic relation)
thm:p15-approximation-rational: identity stated on 0<=x<1 and bound stated on 0<=x<=1/2 before the threshold conclusion is drawn
annex:p15.approximation.rational proof
def:p15-approximation-procedure: state which relation the approximation establishes before comparing an error interval with the threshold
def:p15-w02b-p15-073-lane-model: following-rule estimate q0 = n/tau declared as a model premise

thm:p15-w02b-p15-073-lane-flow: bound q <= nv/L (any spacing with s >= L), identity q = n/(tau+L/v) (time-gap model), q ~ q0 as v -> infinity with n, tau, L fixed; text separates the asymptotic statement from bound and identity and from Mahajan's sim
proof of part (5) names the parameter eps = 1/v in the sense of def:p15-approximation-relations
def:p15-w02b-p15-074-limits item 6: an asymptotic relation supplies no approximation entry until constants and domain are stated
def:p15-w02b-p15-074-procedure step 2: name the relation and obtain a remainder bound with numerical constants on a stated domain before the certificate is applied
thm:p15-approximation-lumping: affine lumping exact, nonlinear remainder bounded by (M/2) sum w_i (x_i - mu)^2 (the nonlinearity test)
annex:p15.approximation.lumping proof, including the two-point nonlinear counterexample

def:p15-approximation-populations: Sec. 6.3.1 typical-state case (identity vs heuristic step, error bound sum d_i) and Sec. 6.4.2 age rectangle (steady-population and participation model, q = 1/2; UK 1950 inversion)
thm:p15-approximation-energy-average: replacing velocities by the momentum average preserves momentum but not kinetic energy (source slabs 6 and 4)
def:p15-approximation-jumps: Sec. 6.3.2 characteristic-value jump model mgh = eta alpha m e, held-fixed parameters, source data, omitted drag scaling
thm:p15-approximation-oscillators with pendulum and derivative lumping (Secs. 6.3.3-6.3.4)
Sec. 6.3.5 atomic-blast characteristic-value argument with its stipulated strong-shock regime
thm:p15-approximation-mechanical-cases: ellipse, ideal Atwood machine, drag-free projectile (Sec. 8.2 two-regime cases) and rolling, each with its model assumptions
annex:p15.approximation.mechanical-cases proof; easy-case limits (equal masses, zero-mass limits, theta = 0 and pi/2) recovered from the equations
thm:p15-approximation-dominance: Sec. 8.2.1.1 A+B regimes with relative errors r/(1+r) and r/(1-r)
def:p15-approximation-drag: creeping-flow vs high-Reynolds regimes, stipulated laws and air values, regime chosen then checked (10 micrometres consistent, 2.5 mm inconsistent)

thm:p15-approximation-rational: explicit interval 1+x <= 1/(1-x) <= 1+x+2x^2 on [0,1/2] decides any threshold outside it
annex:p15.approximation.rational proof
thm:p15-w02b-p15-073-monotone-box (threshold supported exactly when the lower corner exceeds c) and lane-flow part (3) exact ranges
proofs of the monotone-box lemma and the lane-flow theorem

exact arithmetic for both concrete inputs (19/10 < 5 < 10; 10/9 - 221/200 = 11/1800)

thm:p15-approximation-dominance: signed cancellation, error r/(1-r)

defect_observations.observation: The packet's reader_evidence sha256 for handbook/parts/p15/approximate-quantitative-inference.tex (01B76327...) does not match the current file (b977af9a...). The packet locator predates later edits to the host. This does not affect the verdicts.

The reconstructed source cases (typical state, age rectangle, jumps, Atwood machine, projectile, drag regimes, competing energies) have no page-level locators. The only source citations are the chapter-level one at line 10 (Secs. 6.1-6.4, 8.1-8.4) and the page citations at lines 31, 42 and 58. The auditor located the cases in the held PDF at book pp. 203-216, 281-297 and 308-310, and they match. This adds verification cost but is not a coverage gap.

The source's approx sign (delta approx r^2/(2R)) is used here without the explicit omitted-factor statement that lines 54-57 promise wherever the source's stronger approx appears. The regime delta/R << 1 and the exact relation r^2 = 2R delta - delta^2 are both given, so this is not an instance of the C01 failure condition.

This concerns section 173.7, not 173.8. The chapter's finite estimate comes from Mahajan Sec. 1.2 (book pp. 6-7, checked in the held PDF), but unit ED26-SCI-Mahajan2014-001 names chapter 1 Secs. 1.3-1.5 as the extent for the finite estimate example. It bears on ED26-GAP-SCI-002-C04 and does not affect the 173.8 verdicts.
